jobs.title: Parliamentary Assistant
jobs.summary: Alex McIntyre is the Labour MP for Gloucester and this is a permanent post in his Westminster office. The assistant researches parliamentary business, drafts briefings, speeches, press releases and parliamentary questions, and supports casework and communications. They want someone with some experience of politics or writing briefings, strong written communication and Labour values. Applications go by email with a CV and cover letter, interviews are in early December, and the start date is as soon as possible in the New Year.

jobs.title: Parliamentary Assistant
jobs.company: Bridget Phillipson MP (Houghton and Sunderland South)
jobs.summary: Bridget Phillipson is the Labour MP for Houghton and Sunderland South and this is a permanent full-time post in her Westminster office. The assistant drafts speeches, press releases and briefings, tracks legislation, carries out research and manages the diary and events. They want a proactive writer with strong communication skills and an interest in policy, and parliamentary experience is ideal but not essential. Interviews are the week of 7 December with written tasks, the start is January 2027, and applications go by email.

jobs.title: Research and Policy Associate
jobs.location: London (hybrid, 2 days a week in office)
jobs.summary: Runnymede Trust is a race equality think tank that produces research and policy influence on inequality. The associate supports research projects, carries out qualitative and quantitative research and evidence synthesis, and writes reports, policy briefings and consultation responses. They are keen on experience in wealth inequality, poverty and economic justice, and the work also covers migration and community safety. It is a permanent hybrid role, with interviews likely in the weeks of 14 or 21 December, and applications go through CharityJob.

pos: Evidence synthesis like the Home Office placement

jobs.title: Policy Analyst
jobs.summary: Helio Intelligence provides political monitoring and intelligence to clients. The analyst covers Parliament, committees and government announcements, researches government priorities and legislation, and writes alerts, reports and briefings, acting as first contact for a client portfolio. They want a graduate with at least a year in a political, public affairs or policy role, which the Home Office placement would cover, plus strong writing and client-facing skills. It is a permanent London role starting as soon as possible, applied for through an online form.

jobs.title: Impact: The Local Government Graduate Programme (Cohort 29)
jobs.company: Local Government Association (Impact graduate programme, formerly NGDP)
jobs.location: Councils across England and Wales (national applications)
jobs.summary: Impact is the flagship fast-track graduate scheme into local government, run by the Local Government Association with partner councils in England and Wales. Graduates do a two-year paid management trainee programme with at least three placements across a council, including one in the Chief Executive's Office, plus a funded management qualification. They want final-year students or graduates with a 2:2 or above by summer 2027 and the right to work in the UK. Applications close at midday on 6 January 2027, start with an online situational judgement test, and the autumn 2027 intake means you only get one Impact application per year, with some council places limited to local residents.

neg: Some places need a local connection

jobs.title: Caseworker
jobs.summary: Peter Swallow is the Labour MP for Bracknell and this is a permanent post in his constituency office. The caseworker handles constituents' queries and more complex cases on issues such as housing and SEND, drafts replies, researches the subject areas and reports on enquiry trends to the MP. They want strong writing and communication, analytical skills and sensitivity, and casework experience is desirable but not essential. It is 4 or 5 days a week, interviews are in Bracknell on 18 or 21 December, and applications go by email with a CV and covering letter.

neg: Wants a start soon after December interviews, before graduation

jobs.title: Policy and Public Affairs Officer
jobs.summary: Carers UK is the national charity that campaigns for and supports unpaid carers. The policy and public affairs officer monitors and analyses policy developments, works on key policy and campaign projects and engages with carers. The advert lists no set experience, so it suits someone with strong research and communication skills, though it may favour candidates with some policy experience. It is a permanent full-time London post, with a remote first interview in early January and an in-person second stage; apply through the Carers UK website.

pos: Draws on Home Office research experience

jobs.title: External Affairs Intern
jobs.company: Money and Mental Health Policy Institute
jobs.salary_text: £30,128 a year (pro rata for six months)
jobs.summary: The Money and Mental Health Policy Institute is a research and policy charity working to break the link between financial difficulty and mental health problems. This six-month paid training post covers public affairs, campaigning, digital content and events, with structured support for learning. They want someone with confident writing and speaking who can tailor their message to different audiences, and no prior experience is required. It is based in London, with interviews in January and a February 2027 start.

pos: Public affairs and campaigning training role

jobs.title: Policy Researcher / Editorial Research Assistant
jobs.summary: Westminster Forum Projects runs policy conferences that bring together government, industry and campaigners, and this role sits on its Food & Nutrition Forum. You would research and track government policy on food strategy, food poverty, sustainability, land use and trade to keep each conference timely and balanced. They set no formal requirements and ask applicants to explain their interest and relevant academic or work background. The post is permanent, with London or remote working, and the salary is described only as competitive.

jobs.title: Caseworker
jobs.summary: This is the constituency office of the Labour MP for Weston-super-Mare. The caseworker handles constituents' problems on housing, benefits, immigration and public services, liaises with councils and government departments, and drafts letters and research for the MP. They want strong writing, research and analysis, sensitivity with people in difficulty, and sympathy with Labour's values. It is a permanent full-time-style post starting in January, with interviews on 11 and 16 December.

pos: Casework and policy research in an MP's office

jobs.title: Communications and Public Affairs Assistant
jobs.company: Association of Police and Crime Commissioners (APCC)
jobs.summary: The APCC is the national membership body supporting Police and Crime Commissioners across England and Wales. The assistant helps with media work and campaigns, monitors and researches parliamentary activity, writes member and external communications, and helps organise events. They want an early-career communicator who writes clearly and can explain policy to different audiences, working under guidance from senior staff. It is a full-time fixed-term contract until 31 March 2028, based in Westminster, and applications go in by cover letter and CV by email.
